eyebrow: INFORM Sub-national · United Republic of Tanzania
title: See where disasters would hurt most, before they strike.
lead: An open, evidence-based index of disaster risk for every one of Tanzania’s 195 councils and 31 regions, built on the global INFORM methodology and Tanzanian data.

kpi.highRisk: Councils at high risk or above

formula.title: Risk is where hazard, vulnerability and weak coping capacity meet
formula.lead: INFORM combines three dimensions with a geometric mean, so a place is only high-risk when all three are elevated. A strong health system or low poverty genuinely lowers risk, even where floods or droughts are frequent.
formula.equation: Risk = ∛(Hazard & Exposure × Vulnerability × Lack of Coping Capacity)

top.title: Highest-risk councils
top.lead: Ranked by INFORM Risk. Select a council to see what drives its score.
top.distribution: How councils are distributed across risk classes

modules.title: What you can do here
modules.explore: Interactive map of all councils and regions, coloured by risk, any dimension or any of 32 indicators.
modules.insights: National patterns: regional rankings, hazard hot-spots and how the dimensions interact.
modules.severity: Score an unfolding crisis with the official INFORM Severity Index method.
modules.learn: A short course with quizzes that explains risk, from hazards to coping capacity.
modules.methodology: Every formula, threshold and data source, open for scrutiny.
modules.data: Ministries and agencies submit updated data; PMO reviews and approves it.

sources.title: Built on authoritative data
sources.lead: Every indicator is traceable to its authority, dataset and method.

cta.title: Evidence for preparedness, anticipatory action and investment
cta.lead: Use INFORM Tanzania to target preparedness, prioritise investment and brief decision-makers with a transparent, reproducible index.
